verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows AnythingLLM's desktop install is quick and approachable for non-technical users (up and running in minutes, single-install packaging praised), suggesting an easy setup experience, but there's no documented evidence of a structured first-run wizard that walks users through model credentials, channel/integration setup, and default configuration versus manual settings screens. missing for 10: explicit onboarding/wizard documentation covering credential entry flow, channel setup, and default configuration steps; first-party screenshots or docs describing a guided setup sequence.
